output.english_question: Under the UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, can our bank recover a fee at loan closure if that fee had previously been forgiven when the personal loan was sanctioned?
sub_queries: UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions fee forgiveness loan closure recoverability
RBI UCB prepayment closure fee previously waived conditions
UCB RBCD directions customer communication fee waiver foreclosure pre-closure
premises: The fee in question was forgiven (waived) at the time the personal loan was sanctioned.
The same or related fee is sought to be recovered again at loan closure.
